scenes.vo: Last night I found Walt's rules under the register. Rule three was scratched out.
So I held the note up to the fluorescent light. Under the scratches, I could read four words. Never let it... The rest was torn away.
Then the old radio on the shelf crackled to life. It hadn't been plugged in for YEARS.
A voice came through the static. Slow. Tired. Don't read it out loud, kid.
I knew that voice. I had seen his face on the badge. I whispered, Walt? How do I finish rule three?
On the monitor, the tall thing stood right behind me. The radio went quiet. Then Walt laughed, very softly. He said: you already looked once.
